Figures, rates, dates and section numbers never appear in text (SC-2); availability and history are derived from rule versions, never authored (SC-4). s.516 covers both amounts in one sentence; the 1961 Act splits them into ss.288A and 288B, so there is one entry per amount (SC-1 counts the sections an entry's provisions cite).

summary: Advance tax counts as a payment of tax on the income of the year it was payable for, and is credited to the person who paid it.
